about: Resident messages to the maintenance line, labeled against data/knowledge/emergency-sop.md — the development set (rules are tuned against it). 'expected' is P1 | P2 | P3 | non_maintenance. 'weatherF' (optional) is the outside temperature the weather feed reports at that moment. Cases h01–h25 were a holdout until their first run (see docs/engineering-notes.md).

cases.text: Upstairs neighbor has been really loud every night

Hi, hope you're well. A few things: the blinds in the bedroom are broken, the dishwasher is making a weird noise, and the garbage disposal is jammed again. Also my neighbor's dog barks a lot but that's not your problem. Oh and I almost forgot, when I came home tonight there was water coming through the ceiling in the bathroom and it's getting worse. Sorry for the long message, I know you're busy, and thanks for always being so quick to help!
cases.why: long, mixed message; the emergency is buried at the end
